notes: Code Health Intelligence contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12 · corrected 2026-09-12 following Phase 2C evidence-integrity gate. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY · Code Health MEASURES · never judges. `complexity = 18` is a measurement. `complexity = bad` is forbidden. All quality judgement belongs to future NEX2/NEX3 stages.

state_model_boundary.statement: Code Health v0 uses a measurement-specific six-state model. It does NOT redefine, modify, or replace the Evidence Engine v0 state vocabulary.
state_model_boundary.rationale: Code Health measurements are descriptive · they never PASS or FAIL · therefore PASSED / FAILED are intentionally omitted. Evidence Engine keeps its 8-state model because it renders verdicts on engineering claims. Phase 2C did not modify Evidence Engine state vocabulary.

measurement_fields.name: value
measurement_fields.shape: typed value (number or structured) · MUST be null when state !== MEASURED

measurement_fields.name: reproducibility_information
measurement_fields.shape: object · command · cwd · env_fingerprint · node_version · platform

measurement_fields.name: limitations
measurement_fields.shape: string · what this measurement does NOT establish

measurement_fields.name: reason
measurement_fields.shape: string · REQUIRED when state ∈ {NOT_MEASURED · INCONCLUSIVE · BLOCKED · NOT_APPLICABLE · STALE}

measurement_fields.name: delegated_from
measurement_fields.shape: object · REQUIRED when the value is authoritatively supplied by another NEX subsystem · fields: subsystem · subsystem_version · field_reference · upstream_report_id? · upstream_node_id?

measurement_fields.name: attribution
measurement_fields.shape: object · role='code_health_measurement' · authority='descriptive_read_only' · produced_by='code_health_intelligence' · deterministic=true · external_llm_used=false

invariants: no forbidden vocabulary appears anywhere in output
no threshold labels (high · low · excessive) · only raw numbers
every measurement carries tool + tool_version + methodology + reproducibility
measurements provenance-tagged 'delegated_and_verified:*' MUST include a delegated_from block naming the upstream subsystem and field reference · never recompute silently
measurements provenance-tagged 'not_yet_available' MUST emit state=NOT_MEASURED with an explicit reason · MUST NOT emit a fabricated numeric value · MUST NOT fall back to a hidden second detector
empty/broken sources produce NOT_APPLICABLE or INCONCLUSIVE · never MEASURED with an invented value
broken syntax MUST produce state=INCONCLUSIVE with value=null · complexity=0 as a 'lower bound' is prohibited under ordinary cyclomatic_complexity
Code Health v0 state model is measurement-specific and MUST NOT be represented as if it replaced the Evidence Engine v0 state vocabulary (see state_model_boundary)
